prompt: A single text-free landscape bookplate for a tabletop fantasy adventure. The Ash Tithe, an old limestone valley at blue dusk with three close-knit villages, thin grey filaments drawn up from the warm red hearths, one neighbour carrying a last loaf of bread across a courtyard, distant ash-grey mounted collectors. The feeling of a community deciding whom to shelter. Muted indigo, pale limestone, tiny flecks of ember. Gouache and ink on natural paper, art directed like a small literary press book jacket. No lettering, no border, no violence, no spoilers. Wide 3:2 composition.
